classification.difficultyReason: Recognise that 6% refers only to the male subgroup, then multiply the nested proportions to express that subgroup relative to the whole herd.

content.prompt: 15% of a herd of goats are male and 6% of the male goats are older than 4 years of age. What percentage of the total number of goats are male and older than 4 years of age?

answer.worked:
The required percentage is $6\%$ of the $15\%$ that are male.

$$\begin{align*}6\%\text{ of }15\%&=\frac{6}{100}\times\frac{15}{100}\\6\%\text{ of }15\%&=\frac{3}{50}\times\frac{3}{20}\\6\%\text{ of }15\%&=\frac{9}{1000}\\6\%\text{ of }15\%&=0.9\%\end{align*}$$

Therefore, $0.9\%$ of the herd are male and older than 4 years.
